title: Alfred Krupp and Axel Wenner-Gren in Nassau

tellings.quote: the the Maison Rouge meeting. And in 1955, he goes down there with the richest man one of the richest men in the world, Axel Wenner-Gren, a Swedish multi-billionaire.

plain: In 1955 the German industrialist Alfred Krupp went to Nassau, in the Bahamas, with Axel Wenner-Gren, a Swedish multi-billionaire and one of the richest men in the world. A researcher named Jason Simosa tells Michels this without naming a source. He links it to what he calls "the Maison Rouge meeting" and to his argument that the UFO cover-up leads back to one secret society, which would put very rich and powerful men at the centre of that secret if true.
